```rust
use std::collections::HashMap;

// Files from the Kaggle "The Movies Dataset" dump.
const RATINGS: &str = "archive/ratings.csv";   // userId,movieId,rating,timestamp
const LINKS: &str = "archive/links.csv";       // movieId,imdbId,tmdbId
const METADATA: &str = "archive/movies_metadata.csv"; // ...imdb_id...title...
const MIN_VOTES: u32 = 1000; // without this the top 10 is 1-vote 5.0 noise

fn reader(path: &str) -> csv::Reader<std::fs::File> {
    csv::ReaderBuilder::new().flexible(true).from_path(path).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{path}: {e}"))
}
```

  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --print-logs                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)
